instruction: Set up VS Code to automatically generate a unit test file for every new Python class I create, without using any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have built-in code generation capabilities to automatically create unit test files based on class definitions. This would require AI-powered extensions or external tools.
